title: Sr./Staff Data Engineer
description:
About Firework
Join Firework – Where Innovation Meets Impact
Firework is redefining the future of commerce as an AI and video commerce company — combining cutting-edge technology, an exclusive network of enterprise brands and retailers, and a first-mover position to win the agentic commerce race.
We've built the world's most advanced and largest video commerce platform, trusted by global brands and leading retailers. But we're more than software — our compounding network effect grows stronger with every partner we add, bringing the energy of in-store experiences online and transforming how businesses engage, convert, and build lasting customer relationships at scale.
Having raised over $235M to date, led by investors such as SoftBank Vision Fund 2, and operating at global scale, we offer unparalleled opportunities to solve complex challenges and drive meaningful impact in the future of connected commerce.
If you're curious, ambitious, and energized by big ideas — Firework is the place to grow, lead, and shape what comes next. Together.
Summary
We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Senior/Staff Data Engineer to help design, build, and scale our data infrastructure. In this role, you will play a critical part in developing reliable, high-performance data pipelines and systems that power analytics, business intelligence, product development, and data-driven decision-making across the organization.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer with deep expertise in modern data architectures, strong technical problem-solving skills, and a passion for building scalable, efficient, and maintainable data solutions.
Depending on experience and seniority, this role will also provide technical leadership, influence architectural decisions, and help establish engineering best practices across the organization.
What You’ll Be Doing
Responsible for designing, developing, and implementing our backend and machine learning data infrastructure -- including event-based data ingestions, stream processing, data warehouse, data pipelines, visualization, analytics and applications
Build analytics tools that utilize the data pipeline to provide actionable insights into customer acquisition, operational efficiency and other key business performance metrics and develop and maintain distributed data pipelines for ETL, feature engineering, and model running
Create data tools for analytics and data scientist team members that assist them in building and optimizing our product into an innovative industry leader, and keep our data separated and secure across national boundaries through multiple data centers and AWS regions
Work with data and analytics experts to strive for greater functionality in our data systems and our end-to-end data processing, troubleshooting, and problem diagnosis, performance benchmark, load balance, and code reviews
Mentor other data engineers, providing technical guidance, sharing best practices, and supporting their professional development
We’ll be excited if you have
5+ years of professional experience in data engineering, software engineering, or a closely related field, with significant experience designing and maintaining production data or machine learning systems
Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, including advanced querying, data transformations, and performance optimization
Experience building and maintaining large-scale ETL/ELT pipelines and distributed data processing systems
Hands-on experience with modern data warehousing technologies such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or open table format such as Iceberg
Experience with data processing frameworks such as Apache Spark, Flink, or equivalent technologies
Familiarity with workflow orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect
Experience with cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS or GCP
Strong understanding of data modeling, database design, and data architecture principles
Experience implementing data quality, monitoring, and reliability practices in production environments
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently drive complex technical projects
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams
Demonstrated leadership potential and a genuine interest in growing into a people management role, including mentoring engineers, building teams, and driving technical strategy
Locations
The role is hybrid and we are looking for candidates in the Bay Area
Compensation
The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role: The estimated pay range for this role is $160,000-$180,000. Other factors that impact compensation include stock options.
The posted pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the compensation for this position and is subject to change based on business need. To determine a successful candidate’s starting pay, we carefully consider a variety of factors, including primary work location, an evaluation of the candidate’s skills and experience, market demands, and internal parity. Candidates may receive more information from the talent partner.

description:

Having raised over $235M to date, led by investors such as SoftBank Vision Fund 2, and operating at global scale, we offer unparalleled opportunities to solve complex challenges and drive meaningful impact in the future of connected commerce.
If you're curious, ambitious, and energized by big ideas — Firework is the place to grow, lead, and shape what comes next. Together.
Summary
We are looking for a proactive and commercially minded Business Development & Partnerships Manager to own visible, impactful non-linear growth initiatives by identifying, developing, and managing strategic partnership opportunities for Firework. This role will work across external partners and internal teams to support new partnerships, product integrations, and broader strategic initiatives. The ideal candidate is someone ready to take the next step up in their career, comfortable working in a fast-moving environment, can operate with ambiguity, and is able to take ownership of projects from early-stage discussions through execution. You will work closely with senior members of the team while also independently managing partner communications, coordinating cross-functional workstreams, and helping move opportunities forward.
What You'll Be Doing
Support the development and execution of strategic partnerships across technology platforms, retailers, brands, agencies, and other ecosystem partners
Manage day-to-day partner relationships and communications, including with senior external stakeholders
Identify new partnership and business development opportunities and support outreach, evaluation, and follow-up
Help structure partnership proposals, commercial models, business cases, and internal recommendations
Coordinate partnership discussions across internal teams including Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Legal
Support API-led and product integration partnerships, working with Product and Engineering teams to understand partner requirements, timelines, and implementation needs
Track partnership progress, dependencies, deliverables, and next steps to ensure initiatives continue moving forward
Prepare presentations, proposals, meeting materials, and executive-level communications for internal and external audiences
Conduct research and analysis on potential partners, market opportunities, competitors, and broader industry trends
Support broader strategic initiatives, including selected corporate development or strategic evaluation projects where relevant
We’ll be excited if you have
3+ years of professional experience, ideally in partnerships, business development, strategy, consulting, corporate development, or a related role
Exceptional communication skills and the ability to interact confidently and professionally with senior external stakeholders
Demonstrated ability to take ownership, work independently, and proactively move projects forward
Comfortable operating in an environment where priorities and opportunities may not always be clearly defined
Strong organizational and project-management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and workstreams
Strong analytical skills and comfort developing business cases, presentations, and recommendations
Ability to understand commercial and product considerations and translate between different internal teams
Experience working on API integrations, technology partnerships, platform integrations, or other product-led partnerships is highly valued
Experience in Ad Tech, Retail Media Networks, commerce technology, SaaS, or related industries is a plus, but not required
Exposure to corporate development, M&A, strategic investments, or transaction-related work is a plus
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
Locations
The role may be remote and we are looking for candidates based in the Eastern timezone (EST).
Compensation
The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role: The estimated base pay range for this role is $100,000-$120,000. Other factors that impact compensation include variable compensation and stock options.
The posted pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the compensation for this position and is subject to change based on business need. To determine a successful candidate’s starting pay, we carefully consider a variety of factors, including primary work location, an evaluation of the candidate’s skills and experience, market demands, and internal parity. Candidates may receive more information from the talent partner.
Don’t hold back
We understand some candidates may see the above and not apply because they don’t meet all the qualifications. We encourage you to apply anyway; we often find talented candidates that fit many other opportunities we have and look for potential too, not just what you did in the past. As an equal employment opportunity employer, we are a diverse team that strives for an inclusive environment for all. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

title: Sr. Enterprise Account Executive
description:
About Firework
Join Firework – Where Innovation Meets Impact
Firework is revolutionizing connected commerce with the world’s most advanced and largest AI-powered video commerce platform, trusted by global brands and leading retailers. We bring the energy of in-store experiences online, transforming how businesses engage, convert, and build lasting customer relationships.
At Firework, you’ll be part of a high-growth, team-centric environment where innovation thrives and collaboration fuels success. Having raised over $235m to date led by investors such as the SoftBank Vision Fund 2 and operating at a global scale, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work cross-functionally, solve complex challenges, and drive meaningful impact in the future of connected digital commerce.
If you’re curious, ambitious, and energized by big ideas, Firework is the place to grow, lead, and shape the next era of online shopping—together.
Summary
We’re looking for a highly-driven Sr. Enterprise Account Executive professional to own the full sales cycle - from prospecting and discovery through close and account expansion. You’ll evangelize Firework’s innovative solutions to large enterprise brands and retailers across a variety of industries in the North America market. You thrive identifying and closing key opportunities with organizations that have complex needs to continuously generate new revenue.
What You'll Be Doing
Work cross-functionally with the team to set priorities and make key strategic decisions for identifying, qualifying, and pursuing new business opportunities with enterprise accounts across multiple industries
Own the entire enterprise sales cycle from prospecting, initial outreach, lead qualification, discovery, demo, solution design, negotiation, and close
Grow, establish, and nurture long-term relationships with key decision-makers by understanding their business objectives and strategic priorities and delivering value in order to meet assigned revenue goals
Prepare and deliver compelling presentations, product demos, and customized proposals tailored to executive audiences
Partner closely with Customer Success, Product, and Integration Solutions to align on strategies to ensure successful integration and world-class customer experiences
Collaborate with leadership to continuously refine processes, playbooks, and frameworks that help shape and scale go-to-market strategies efficiently
We'll be excited if you have
3+ years experience in a full-cycle enterprise-level sales experience, with a proven track record of success in acquiring new business and exceeding sales targets
Extensive experience with outbound prospecting, cultivating a territory, and building and closing a robust pipeline of high-value contracts and complex deals
Mastery of solution-based selling, complex sales methodologies, and consultative approaches
Ability to create and multiply a sales playbook to influence stakeholders on the value proposition and deliver results through multi-threaded evaluations
Skilled in leading and navigating multi-threaded enterprise sales cycles (multiple personas and decision paths)
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to present effectively to technical and non-technical audiences of all levels including executives
Extensive experience with various sales tools and tech stack (i.e. Salesforce, Apollo, LinkedIn, etc)
AI fluency and a proactive approach to adopting AI tools to strengthen prospecting, personalize outreach, streamline sales workflows, and improve productivity
Comfortable with change in a high-growth organization: ability to demonstrate comfort with ambiguity, adapt quickly and be effective in new situations in a highly dynamic setting
Start-up mentality; you are team-oriented, resilient, empathetic, and no ego
Locations
The role may be remote. For remote, we are looking for candidates based in the United States.
Compensation
The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role: The estimated base pay range is approximately $100K-$120K. Other factors that impact compensation include commission and stock options.
Don’t hold back
We understand some candidates may see the above and not apply because they don’t meet all the qualifications. We encourage you to apply anyway; we often find talented candidates that fit many other opportunities we have and look for potential too, not just what you did in the past. title: Digital Showroom Host
description:
About Firework
Join Firework - Where Innovation Meets Impact
Firework is redefining the future of commerce as an AI and video commerce company — combining cutting-edge technology, an exclusive network of enterprise brands and retailers, and a first-mover position to win the agentic commerce race.
We've built the world's most advanced and largest video commerce platform, trusted by global brands and leading retailers. But we're more than software — our compounding network effect grows stronger with every partner we add, bringing the energy of in-store experiences online and transforming how businesses engage, convert, and build lasting customer relationships at scale.
Having raised over $235M to date, led by investors such as SoftBank Vision Fund 2, and operating at global scale, we offer unparalleled opportunities to solve complex challenges and drive meaningful impact in the future of connected commerce.
If you're curious, ambitious, and energized by big ideas — Firework is the place to grow, lead, and shape what comes next. Together.
Summary
Lights on. Camera live. That’s you! From our Hollywood studio, you’ll host professionally produced live commerce shows for some of the world’s top brands - presenting products in a way that feels like a real conversation, not a rehearsal pitch. You’ll come in prepared: product briefings, rehearsals, and run-throughs are part of the deal so that when the camera goes live, you’re fully in your element. Show after show, you bring energy, polish, and the kind of screen presence that helps audiences discover, engage, and shop in real time.
What You’ll Be Doing
Host engaging, live product shows from Firework’s Hollywood studio
Present products in a way that feels natural, conversational, and authentic
Bring brand messaging to life while keeping delivery unscripted and relatable
Participate in training, product briefings, rehearsals, and show run-throughs
Adapt your tone and style to match different brands and audiences
Maintain strong on-camera presence and professionalism during live broadcasts
We’ll be excited if you have
Confident, engaging on-camera presence
Ability to explain products like you’re talking to a friend - not reading a script
Reliable, punctual, and open to feedback and coaching
Experience in hosting, livestreaming, UGC, acting, or product demos is a plus - but not required
Availability during weekday business hours
Schedule
On-site only at our Hollywood studio (all training, rehearsals, and shows)
Typically 5-10 hours per week, including prep and showtime. May increase for clients with multiple shows per month or complex products.
Primarily weekday schedules, with occasional planned weekend sessions
Shows typically run 8:00am-8:00pm PT, depending on client needs
Compensation
$25-$40 per hour depending on experience and client scope
1099 contractor to start

Summary
We are seeking an experienced GRC & Privacy Consultant to lead and manage our ongoing SOC 2, GDPR, and broader Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) initiatives. This individual will be responsible for maintaining compliance programs, coordinating security and privacy assessments, managing regulatory requirements, and serving as a key point of contact for customer-facing security and compliance inquiries.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on compliance professional who can independently manage day-to-day compliance activities, partner with internal technical and business teams, and support customer and contractual compliance requirements.
What You’ll Be Doing
SOC 2 & Security Compliance
Manage ongoing SOC 2 compliance activities, including audit readiness, evidence collection, and coordination with external auditors
Conduct periodic access control reviews and vendor risk assessments
Review, maintain, and update security and compliance policies
Oversee data deletion processes to ensure alignment with applicable policies and regulatory requirements
Coordinate incident response, disaster recovery, and business continuity tabletop exercises
Oversee penetration testing activities, including coordination with external providers, tracking findings, and remediation follow-up
GDPR, EU AI Act & Privacy Management
Manage GDPR compliance activities and support organizational readiness for applicable EU AI Act requirements
Conduct privacy and compliance reviews of product designs, features, and processes
Coordinate and respond to Data Subject Access Requests (DSARs) and other privacy-related requests
Review and document data flows, processing activities, and data handling practices
Maintain Records of Processing Activities (RoPA) and related privacy documentation
Partner with internal stakeholders to identify and address privacy, data protection, and AI governance risks
Customer-Facing GRC & Contract Support
Serve as the primary point of contact for customer security, privacy, and compliance inquiries
Complete customer security questionnaires and respond to due diligence requests
Participate in customer calls to address SOC 2, GDPR, data protection, and security-related questions
Review customer contracts, Data Processing Agreements (DPAs), and security-related terms
Provide contract redlines and recommendations related to privacy, security, and compliance obligations, coordinating with legal counsel as needed
Security Monitoring & Risk Management
Review security alerts, vulnerability findings, and relevant system logs using tools such as Intruder.io, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS, and application logging systems
Coordinate with engineering and infrastructure teams to investigate findings and track remediation
Identify compliance gaps, assess risks, and recommend process improvements
Maintain compliance documentation, risk registers, and supporting evidence
We'll be excited if you have
Demonstrated experience managing SOC 2 compliance programs and supporting external audits
Strong working knowledge of GDPR, data privacy requirements, and GRC best practices
Familiarity with the EU AI Act and emerging AI governance requirements
Experience conducting vendor risk assessments, access reviews, and security policy reviews
Experience responding to customer security questionnaires, due diligence requests, and compliance inquiries
Ability to review security and privacy provisions in commercial agreements and DPAs
Familiarity with cloud security environments, particularly GCP and AWS
Understanding of security monitoring, vulnerability management, penetration testing, and incident response processes
Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally with Engineering, Legal, Sales, and leadership
Ability to independently manage multiple compliance workstreams in a consulting capacity
Anticipated Hours
Approximately 10-15 hours per week, potentially increasing to 20-30 hours per week during compliance audits and certification periods
Locations
The role may be hybrid in one of our offices or remote. For remote, we are looking for candidates based in the United States
